{"version":1,"view":"custom","query":{"where":[{"field":"path","operator":"contains","value":"article/"},{"field":"frontmatter.date","operator":"exists"}],"sort":{"field":"frontmatter.date","direction":"desc"},"limit":500},"js":"const textOf = value => Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String).join(\", \") : value == null ? \"\" : String(value);\nconst platformOf = source => {\n  const match = textOf(source).match(/^https?:\\/\\/(?:www\\.|m\\.)?([^/:?#]+)/i);\n  return match ? match[1] : \"기타\";\n};\nconst unique = values => [...new Set(values.map(value => textOf(value).trim()).filter(Boolean))].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, \"ko\"));\nconst categories = unique(notes.map(note => note.frontmatter.category));\nconst tags = unique(notes.flatMap(note => Array.isArray(note.frontmatter.tags) ? note.frontmatter.tags : [note.frontmatter.tags]));\nconst platforms = unique(notes.map(note => platformOf(note.frontmatter.source)));\nconst search = String(state.search || \"\").trim().toLocaleLowerCase();\nconst category = String(state.category || \"\");\nconst tag = String(state.tag || \"\");\nconst platform = String(state.platform || \"\");\nconst readFilter = String(state.read || \"all\");\nconst dateFrom = String(state.dateFrom || \"\");\nconst dateTo = String(state.dateTo || \"\");\nconst sort = String(state.sort || \"date-desc\");\nconst sortDesc = sort.endsWith(\"-desc\");\nconst sortKey = sort.replace(/-(?:asc|desc)$/, \"\");\nconst filtered = notes.filter(note => {\n  const metadata = note.frontmatter || {};\n  const noteTags = Array.isArray(metadata.tags) ? metadata.tags.map(String) : metadata.tags ? [String(metadata.tags)] : [];\n  const noteDate = textOf(metadata.date).slice(0, 10);\n  const notePlatform = platformOf(metadata.source);\n  const searchText = [note.title, note.path, metadata.summary, metadata.category, noteTags.join(\" \"), notePlatform, metadata.date]\n    .map(textOf).join(\" \").toLocaleLowerCase();\n  return (!search || searchText.includes(search))\n    && (!category || textOf(metadata.category) === category)\n    && (!tag || noteTags.includes(tag))\n    && (!platform || notePlatform === platform)\n    && (readFilter === \"all\" || (readFilter === \"read\" ? metadata.read === true : metadata.read !== true))\n    && (!dateFrom || noteDate >= dateFrom)\n    && (!dateTo || noteDate <= dateTo);\n});\nconst sortValue = note => {\n  const metadata = note.frontmatter || {};\n  if (sortKey === \"title\") return textOf(note.title);\n  if (sortKey === \"category\") return textOf(metadata.category);\n  if (sortKey === \"read\") return metadata.read === true ? 1 : 0;\n  return textOf(metadata.date).slice(0, 10);\n};\nfiltered.sort((left, right) => {\n  const a = sortValue(left);\n  const b = sortValue(right);\n  const compared = typeof a === \"number\" && typeof b === \"number\" ? a - b : String(a).localeCompare(String(b), \"ko\", { numeric: true });\n  return sortDesc ? -compared : compared;\n});\nconst pageSize = 40;\nconst pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / pageSize));\nconst currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(Number(state.page) || 1, 1), pageCount);\nconst visible = filtered.slice((currentPage - 1) * pageSize, currentPage * pageSize);\nconst options = (values, selected) => '<option value=\"\"' + (selected ? \"\" : ' selected=\"selected\"') + '>전체</option>'\n  + values.map(value => '<option value=\"' + escapeHtml(value) + '\"' + (value === selected ? ' selected=\"selected\"' : \"\") + '>' + escapeHtml(value) + '</option>').join(\"\");\nconst rows = visible.map(note => {\n  const metadata = note.frontmatter || {};\n  const noteTags = Array.isArray(metadata.tags) ? metadata.tags.map(String).join(\", \") : textOf(metadata.tags);\n  const noteDate = textOf(metadata.date).slice(0, 10);\n  const patch = escapeHtml(JSON.stringify({ read: metadata.read !== true }));\n  const summary = textOf(metadata.summary || note.excerpt).slice(0, 220);\n  return \"<tr><td><form data-fn-event='note.frontmatter.patch' data-note-id='\" + note.id + \"'><input type='hidden' name='patch' value='\" + patch + \"'><button type='submit'>\" + (metadata.read === true ? \"읽음\" : \"미읽음\") + \"</button></form></td>\"\n    + \"<td><button type='button' data-fn-event='note.open' data-note-id='\" + note.id + \"'>\" + escapeHtml(note.title) + \"</button><p class='article-summary'>\" + escapeHtml(summary || \"요약 없음\") + \"</p></td>\"\n    + \"<td>\" + escapeHtml(textOf(metadata.category) || \"—\") + \"</td><td>\" + escapeHtml(noteTags || \"—\") + \"</td>\"\n    + \"<td>\" + escapeHtml(platformOf(metadata.source)) + \"</td><td>\" + escapeHtml(noteDate || \"—\") + \"</td></tr>\";\n}).join(\"\");\nconst pageNumber = value => '<button type=\"button\" data-fn-event=\"state.set\" data-state-key=\"page\" data-state-value=\"' + value + '\"' + (value === currentPage ? ' disabled=\"disabled\"' : \"\") + '>' + value + '</button>';\nconst html = \"<section class='article-view'><header class='article-heading'><div><h2>아티클 아카이브</h2><p>총 \" + notes.length + \"편 · 조건 일치 \" + filtered.length + \"편</p></div><label>정렬<select data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='sort' aria-label='정렬'>\"\n  + [\"date-desc\", \"date-asc\", \"title-asc\", \"title-desc\", \"category-asc\", \"category-desc\", \"read-desc\", \"read-asc\"].map(value => '<option value=\"' + value + '\"' + (sort === value ? ' selected=\"selected\"' : \"\") + '>' + ({ \"date-desc\": \"최신 날짜순\", \"date-asc\": \"오래된 날짜순\", \"title-asc\": \"제목 오름차순\", \"title-desc\": \"제목 내림차순\", \"category-asc\": \"카테고리 오름차순\", \"category-desc\": \"카테고리 내림차순\", \"read-desc\": \"읽음 우선\", \"read-asc\": \"미읽음 우선\" }[value]) + '</option>').join(\"\")\n  + \"</select></label></header><div class='article-controls'><label>검색<input type='search' data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='search' value='\" + escapeHtml(state.search || \"\") + \"' placeholder='제목·요약·태그 검색'></label>\"\n  + \"<label>카테고리<select data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='category' aria-label='카테고리'>\" + options(categories, category) + \"</select></label>\"\n  + \"<label>태그<select data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='tag' aria-label='태그'>\" + options(tags, tag) + \"</select></label>\"\n  + \"<label>플랫폼<select data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='platform' aria-label='플랫폼'>\" + options(platforms, platform) + \"</select></label>\"\n  + \"<label>읽음 상태<select data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='read' aria-label='읽음 상태'><option value='all'\" + (readFilter === \"all\" ? ' selected=\"selected\"' : \"\") + \">전체</option><option value='read'\" + (readFilter === \"read\" ? ' selected=\"selected\"' : \"\") + \">읽음</option><option value='unread'\" + (readFilter === \"unread\" ? ' selected=\"selected\"' : \"\") + \">미읽음</option></select></label>\"\n  + \"<label>시작일<input type='date' data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='dateFrom' value='\" + escapeHtml(dateFrom) + \"'></label><label>종료일<input type='date' data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='dateTo' value='\" + escapeHtml(dateTo) + \"'></label></div>\"\n  + \"<div class='article-table-wrap'><table><thead><tr><th scope='col'>읽음</th><th scope='col'>아티클</th><th scope='col'>카테고리</th><th scope='col'>태그</th><th scope='col'>플랫폼</th><th scope='col'>날짜</th></tr></thead><tbody>\"\n  + (rows || \"<tr><td colspan='6'>조건에 맞는 아티클이 없습니다.</td></tr>\") + \"</tbody></table></div>\"\n  + \"<footer class='article-page'><span>\" + (filtered.length ? ((currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1) + \"–\" + Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, filtered.length) + \" / \" + filtered.length + \"편\" : \"0편\") + \"</span><div class='article-page-buttons'><button type='button' data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='page' data-state-value='\" + Math.max(1, currentPage - 1) + \"'\" + (currentPage === 1 ? \" disabled='disabled'\" : \"\") + \">이전</button><span>\" + currentPage + \" / \" + pageCount + \"</span><button type='button' data-fn-event='state.set' data-state-key='page' data-state-value='\" + Math.min(pageCount, currentPage + 1) + \"'\" + (currentPage === pageCount ? \" disabled='disabled'\" : \"\") + \">다음</button></div></footer></section>\";\nconst css = \".article-view { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .article-heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .article-heading label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .article-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 8px; } .article-controls label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; } .article-controls input { min-width: 0; } .article-controls select { min-width: 0; } .article-table-wrap { overflow: auto; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 8px; } .article-table-wrap table { width: 100%; min-width: 760px; } .article-table-wrap th { padding: 8px; text-align: left; } .article-table-wrap td { padding: 8px; border-top: 1px solid currentColor; } .article-summary { opacity: .75; } .article-page { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .article-page-buttons { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }\";\nreturn { html, css };"}
